description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka Accounting Standards Changes w.e.f. 01st January, 2017 (E only)
reasoning: This gazette content involves the publication of changes to Sri Lanka Accounting Standards (SLFRS & LKAS) under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for financial reporting, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. The content does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
